policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists India as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Indian passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The schedule's no-visa category means a visa is not required; work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa baseline
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board table makes arrival issuance conditional for India; otherwise it directs the traveller to obtain a visa from the closest Jordanian Embassy before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Indian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who is not travelling through a qualifying tour operator and does not hold the listed GCC residence or Schengen, UK or United States visa.
The official table expressly preserves those conditional arrival-visa routes; they do not change this ordinary-passport baseline.
All non-Jordanians must obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure; work, residence, transit, special documents, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Jordan's live India row permits arrival issuance only with a tour operator or listed third-country residence/visa; otherwise it requires an embassy visa before arrival.

Burkina Faso's electronic service demonstrates an online workflow but does not publish ordinary Indian-passport eligibility or an exhaustive non-exempt complement.
Current Cabo Verde official pages do not map an Indian ordinary passport to an arrival, electronic, or advance-visa route; EASE registration is not itself an issuance classification.
